title: Code and simulation outputs for: How Withheld Punishment Sustains Anti-Democratic Behavior in an Evolutionary Game
description: R scripts, generated C++ simulator source, reference outputs, and the standalone LaTeX source of Figure 1 for the article "How Withheld Punishment Sustains Anti-Democratic Behavior in an Evolutionary Game" (Chad M. Topaz). The scripts reproduce Figures 2-4, the numerical checks of Propositions 1 and 2, and every number quoted in the article's finite-population results. See README.md for requirements, execution order, seeds, expected outputs, and runtimes.
